title: Research Analyst I, Pediatric Developmental Medicine

cond_0001.intro: Under direct supervision, provide support for research related to autism spectrum disorders. This includes providing support for psychologists and research staff working with families of children with autism spectrum disorder, reviewing medical and educational records, providing administrative support for the laboratory, assisting in general laboratory maintenance, and collecting, entering, and assisting in the organization and analysis of data.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Collect and organize data from a variety of reference sources
Prepare charts, graphs, and tables according to accepted research practices
Perform preliminary analysis
Assist in investigating and gathering data
Route questionnaires, record information and distribute results using established procedures
Assist with recruiting and interviewing study participants
Review and extract pertinent information from medical and educational records
Provide appropriate documentation for research
Update manual and/or automated database file and maintain records
Assist in the preparation of materials for publication
Edit and/or type manuscripts according to accepted practices
Keep abreast of trends in field of study
Read professional journals and attend meetings and/or seminars
Support psychologists and research staff during participant appointments
Consent families for research
Assist in supervising children during research appointments
Potentially assist with administering cognitive and adaptive measures
May supervise student assistants
Plan and assign work
May assist in lab maintenance
Order supplies and equipment
Monitor and maintain inventory control
Ensure that the appropriate materials are set up and taken down for research appointments
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with the field of developmental disabilities

Perform preliminary analysis
Assist in investigating and gathering data
Route questionnaires, record information, and distribute results using established procedures
Assist with recruiting study participants and conducting interviews
Review and extract pertinent information from medical and educational records
Provide appropriate documentation for research
Update manual and/or automated database files and maintain records
Assist in the preparation of materials for publication
Edit and/or type manuscripts according to accepted practices
Keep abreast of trends in field of study

Obtain consent from families for research

May supervise student assistants
Plan and assign work
May assist in lab maintenance
Order supplies and equipment
Monitor and maintain inventory control
Ensure that the appropriate materials are set up and taken down for research appointments
